title: genista glabrescens
intro: Genista glabrescens, commonly known as the smooth broom or broom genista, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family. It is a deciduous shrub native to the Iberian Peninsula and western Mediterranean region. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Genista glabrescens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
